name: Primeape
description: If approached while asleep, it may awaken and angrily give chase in a groggy state of semi-sleep.

moves.name: Scratch
moves.description: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe to inflict damage.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The foe is given an intimidating leer with sharp eyes. The target’s Defense stat is reduced.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses to raise the critical-hit ratio of its attacks.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Fury Swipes
moves.description: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes for two to five times in quick succession.

moves.name: Karate Chop
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Seismic Toss
moves.description: The foe is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user’s level.

moves.name: Screech
moves.description: An earsplitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Assurance
moves.description: If the foe has already taken some damage in the same turn, this attack’s power is doubled.

moves.name: Rage
moves.description: While this move is in use, it gains attack power each time the user is hit in battle.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Cross Chop
moves.description: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Thrash
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. It then becomes confused, however.

moves.name: Punishment
moves.description: This attack’s power increases the more the foe has powered up with stat changes.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the foe up close without guarding itself. It also cuts the user’s Defense and Sp. Def.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The foe is attacked with a powerful beam. The user must rest on the next turn to regain its energy.

moves.name: Strength
moves.description: The foe is slugged with a punch thrown at maximum power. It can also be used to move boulders.

moves.name: Thunderbolt
moves.description: A strong electric blast is loosed at the foe. It may also leave the foe paralyzed.

moves.name: Thunder
moves.description: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the foe to inflict damage. It may also leave the target paralyzed.

moves.name: Earthquake
moves.description: The user sets off an earthquake that hits all the Pokémon in the battle.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows, then attacks on the second turn. It can also be used to exit dungeons.

moves.name: Toxic
moves.description: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

moves.name: Double Team
moves.description: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to raise its evasiveness.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. It fully restores the user’s HP and heals any status problem.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe to inflict damage. It may also make the target flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user makes a copy of itself using some of its HP. The copy serves as the user’s decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the foe’s held item simultaneously. It can’t steal if the user holds an item.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: It enables the user to evade all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Swagger
moves.description: The user enrages the foe into confusion. However, it also sharply raises the foe’s Attack stat.

moves.name: Attract
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe becomes infatuated and less likely to attack.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

moves.name: Return
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the more the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Frustration
moves.description: A full-power attack that grows more powerful the less the user likes its Trainer.

moves.name: Iron Tail
moves.description: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may also lower the target’s Defense stat.

moves.name: Hidden Power
moves.description: A unique attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the Pokémon using it.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water- type moves.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

moves.name: Rock Smash
moves.description: The user hits with a punch that may lower the target’s Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: An attack move that doubles its power if the user is poisoned, paralyzed, or has a burn.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. It will fail if the user is hit before it is used.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for two to four turns.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with tough fists, etc. It can also break any barrier such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Secret Power
moves.description: The user attacks with a secret power. Its added effects vary depending on the user’s environment.

moves.name: Overheat
moves.description: The user attacks the foe at full power. The attack’s recoil sharply reduces the user’s Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It also lowers the foe’s Speed by preventing its movement.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the foe with speed, then slashes. The attack lands without fail.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting both its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Natural Gift
moves.description: The user draws power to attack by using its held Berry. The Berry determines its type and power.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.description: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.

moves.name: Payback
moves.description: If the user can use this attack after the foe attacks, its power is doubled.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the foe to attack. Its power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The foe is stabbed with a tentacle or arm steeped in poison. It may also poison the foe.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. It may also lower the target’s Sp. Def.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the foe using every bit of its power. The user must rest on the next turn.

moves.name: Rock Climb
moves.description: A charging attack that may also leave the foe confused. It can also be used to scale rocky walls.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the foe with a sharpened stone. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

moves.name: Captivate
moves.description: If it is the opposite gender of the user, the foe is charmed into sharply lowering its Sp. Atk stat.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.description: The user attacks with its head. It may make the foe flinch. To find Pokémon, hit trees.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the foe fall over. It inflicts greater damage on heavier foes.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the foe. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Spite
moves.description: The user looses its grudge on the move last used by the foe by cutting 4 PP from it.

moves.name: Mud-Slap
moves.description: The user hurls mud in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

moves.name: Outrage
moves.description: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. However, it then becomes confused.

moves.name: Uproar
moves.description: The user attacks in an uproar for two to five turns. Over that time, no one can fall asleep.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: A move that boosts the power of the ally’s attack in a Double Battle.

moves.name: Role Play
moves.description: The user mimics the foe completely, copying the foe’s natural ability.

moves.name: Endeavor
moves.description: An attack move that cuts down the foe’s HP to equal the user’s HP.

moves.name: Seed Bomb
moves.description: The user slams a barrage of hard- shelled seeds down on the foe from above.

moves.name: Vacuum Wave
moves.description: The user whirls its fists to send a wave of pure vacuum at the foe. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Gunk Shot
moves.description: The user shoots filthy garbage at the foe to attack. It may also poison the target.
